results.title: Pride Comedy Show 2026
results.overview: On the occasion of Pride 2026, a special spotlight is shone on the Pride Comedy Show, which made its way to Quebec as part of the 2026 Just For Laughs festival. Dedicated this year to cinema, this brand-new evening celebrates the pride of being oneself through the talents of the francophone LGBTQIA+ comedy scene. A festive, inclusive, and unapologetic event, brought together under the banner of laughter and living together.

results.title: Uncle Artoo
results.overview: The name Nosferatu conjures fear and horror in the hearts of many. But what if the famous vampire wanted to change? A documentary crew follows Nosferatu as he raises foster children, whilst trying not to fall back into old habits.

results.title: The Purgatory: The Kill Zone
results.overview: In the near future of South Korea, where it became lawless due to an economic crisis, a new authoritarian government implements the "Permanent Exile Law" to easily control the country. According to this law, death row inmates are permanently exiled to a detention center, the Purgatory, built in abandoned nuclear power plants. With a degree of self-governance granted by the government, the Purgatory gradually reaches a point where it is beyond external control, leaving the government struggling to find a solution. Yu-seong, a police officer who became a death row inmate due to the revenge for his daughter and wife, is offered a deal by the Director of NIS. Now Yu-seong must eliminate the Purgatory Boss, the king of the center, in exchange for possible pardon.

results.title: The Shrine
results.overview: Yu-mi and her friends are staying in a small Japanese town. When Hee-jung doesn't return home for dinner, they decide to visit the shrine from her painting. Strange occurrences startle them as they explore the shrine, even some end up injuring themselves. Yu-mi senses a sinister presence lurking within. She knows the right person for this, her old shaman friend named Myung-jin. Leaving the past behind with Yu-mi, he joins Pastor Han-ju, a spiritual leader of the town. Their mysterious cooperation to keep everyone safe is about to begin.

results.title: Nine
results.overview: They thought they were coming back to a house. Instead, they lose themselves inside a mind. And some won't make it out. Nine is a psychological thriller that dives deep into a mind at war - an intimate yet universal experience about the courage it takes to fully exist.

results.title: Operation Taco Gary's
results.overview: Two brothers uncover an alien invasion hidden inside a fast-food chain and must save Earth.

results.title: Neil Peart: No One's Disciple
results.overview: Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson team up with four revered drummers — Stewart Copeland, Danny Carey, Chad Smith, and Gavin Harrison — for an exhilarating and poignant tribute to late Rush legend Neil Peart.

results.title: Final Orbit
results.overview: Across a dying Earth and the far reaches of space, humanity faces its final tests. Stranded astronauts, desperate survivors, conflicted pilots and an isolated diplomat must decide what is worth saving before time runs out.

results.title: Nuptials
results.overview: A young couple on their honeymoon is forced to experience each other’s darkest desires. As the lines between reality and sanity blur, a sinister presence keeps them trapped in their bridal suite and tries to seduce them towards unbearable truths.

results.title: Be Yourself
results.overview: Wu Xiao Bei, a girl born in the 2000s, suffered from a sudden breakup. After falling out of love, she repeatedly jumped into madness and decadence and finally decided to fight back! Xiao Bei stumbled through the "12 things not to do after falling out of love": transform yourself, pretend to be rational, and deal with all kinds of people from the opposite sex... However, can this long list of tips for a lovelorn really lead her out of her heartbreak?

results.title: Santo
results.overview: A traffic accident brings two young delivery riders together in São Paulo. Yuri, free-spirited and provocative, and Davi, hardworking and guided by his faith, find themselves caught between religion and the freedom of the streets.

results.title: Irving Berlin's Top Hat
results.overview: Inspired by the iconic 1935 movie musical starring Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, this acclaimed Chichester Festival Theatre revival recorded from the West End in January 2026 is directed and choreographed by three-time Tony winner Kathleen Marshall.

results.title: Eva
results.overview: Eva, a mysterious woman who lives in the forest, sets a field of sunflowers on fire. She tells the police commissioner who arrests her that she did it because the children are in danger and must be protected. Eva believes she has a mission and she talks like a preacher, a sort of Joan of Arc. She sees strange blue lights in the sky. Her case is associated with the mysterious disappearance of children that have been occurring in the area, even if the youngsters seem to gladly follow her around. In the meantime, in China, a woman is exasperated because her daughter is sick.

results.title: Three Housewives and a Body
results.overview: Lorelai loves living in her neighborhood, right next to best friends Jackie and Ella. During girl's night at Jackie's house a home invasion goes terribly wrong when the three women accidentally kill a man.

results.title: Petrushka
results.overview: Petya is almost 40 years old, he works as a chef in a restaurant and by his age he had achieved little in life. Petya has a wife and two children, but he is not respected by them. One day, he goes to his parents cottage, where he finds a box of old toys. Among them, he finds his favorite toy, Petrushka, because his name is the same as his own. Petya puts Petrushka on his arm, and a miracle happens - the toy comes to life. Now Petya has a difficult struggle with his alter ego, which will make him a real man.

results.title: friends
results.overview: Two friends are walking and having a talk about their relationships by the sea.

results.title: Effi o Blaenau
results.overview: Hard-partying young woman Effi lives in rural Wales, whose life largely revolves around drinking vodka with her friends and eating instant noodles to cure her subsequent hangovers – until her life suddenly changes dramatically.

results.title: Antartica - Quasi una fiaba
results.overview: A small group of scientists, unreachable for eight months, explores the future of humanity. Maria Medri, a foreign genius, arrives in Antarctica, challenging Fulvio Cadorna's plans. They are similar but conflicting, as everyone desires their own. This scientific, ideological, and emotional conflict unfolds.

results.title: Out of Breath
results.overview: OUT OF BREATH shines the spotlight on the human cost paid by people living with sleep apnea and their loved ones. Yet, for all the darkness they face there is also light at the end of the tunnel as their hope, courage, and perseverance brings them closer to the promise of successful treatment.
